1
Ab Saqifa Ko Na Dunya Se Chopaya Jaye.
Kis Ne Mara Hai Fatima Ko Bataya Jaye.
Beti Ka Haq Nahi Tu Haq Kaisa Hai.
Tum Ghulamo Ko Bhi Mimber Par Bithaya Jaye.

2
Farman-e-Nabi Jis Ne Jhutlaya Tha.
Oss Ko Keh Kar Na Razi ALLAH Bulaya Jaye.
Aawaz Sun Rahe They Nabi Arshon Par.
Fatima Zahra Ka Darwaza Jalaya Jaye.

3
Tehreer-e-Muhammad Hai Quran Zalim.
Boli Zahra Na Youn Qadmo Mein Giraya Jaye.
Bas Joun Ki Ibadat Yeh Hi Logo.
Dushman-e-Zahra Pe Tabarah Lagaya Jaye.

from pathlib import Path
import re
p = Path(\"src/data/lyrics/ab-saqifa-ko-na-dunya-se-chopaya-jaye-tajpoints-6aef22f4d7751e354f49.md\")
_, meta, body = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
for section, numbers in [(roman, '123'), (body, '۱۲۳')]:
    groups = re.split(r'\\n\\s*\\n', section.strip())
    assert len(groups) == 3
    for group, number in zip(groups, numbers):
        lines = [line.strip() for line in group.splitlines()]
        assert len(lines) == 5 and lines[0] == number
        assert all(not line.endswith('.') for line in lines[1:])
assert 'noUrdu' not in meta and 'direction: \"rtl\"' in meta
print('Verified three aligned four-verse stanzas and Urdu metadata.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 12 verses in Urdu script and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both versions follow the same three-stanza structure. Updated the Urdu title and right-to-left direction, retained the Roman title as `alternateTitle`, and cleared `noUrdu`.

I read `Razi ALLAH` as `راضی اللہ` and `Tabarah` as `تبرّا`.
